description: Source code for command resolution and executable path handling in a Node.js environment, including functions for parsing commands, resolving paths, matching allowlists, and tokenizing command-line arguments.

methods.name: isCommandResolution
methods.description: Type guard to check if a resolution is a CommandResolution.

methods.name: parseFirstToken
methods.description: Parses the first token from a command string, handling quotes.

methods.name: tryResolveRealpath
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the real path of a file, returning undefined on failure.

methods.name: buildExecutableResolution
methods.description: Builds an ExecutableResolution object with resolved paths and executable name.

methods.name: buildCommandResolution
methods.description: Constructs a CommandResolution object with execution and policy resolutions.

methods.name: resolveCommandResolution
methods.description: Resolves a command string into a CommandResolution object.

methods.name: resolveCommandResolutionFromArgv
methods.description: Resolves command from argv array into a CommandResolution object.

methods.name: resolveExecutableCandidatePathFromResolution
methods.description: Gets the candidate path from an ExecutableResolution, resolving if necessary.

methods.name: resolveExecutionTargetResolution
methods.description: Extracts the execution target resolution from a command or executable resolution.

methods.name: resolvePolicyTargetResolution
methods.description: Extracts the policy target resolution from a command or executable resolution.

methods.name: resolveExecutionTargetCandidatePath
methods.description: Gets the candidate path for the execution target.

methods.name: resolvePolicyTargetCandidatePath
methods.description: Gets the candidate path for the policy target.

methods.name: resolveApprovalAuditCandidatePath
methods.description: Alias for policy target candidate path, used for audit purposes.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistCandidatePath
methods.description: Legacy alias for execution target candidate path.

methods.name: resolvePolicyAllowlistCandidatePath
methods.description: Alias for policy target candidate path.

methods.name: stripTrailingRedirections
methods.description: Removes trailing shell redirection tokens from command strings.

methods.name: matchArgPattern
methods.description: Matches command-line arguments against a pattern, considering platform and redirections.

methods.name: matchAllowlist
methods.description: Checks if a given executable resolution and argv match any allowlist entries.

methods.name: parseExecArgvToken
methods.description: Tokenizes a command-line argument into a normalized model.
